records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Granite Media!
records.body:
Hi Ben,

records.text: New signup alert -- *Granite Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Account created first project on day 4 (some real engagement), but no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:ff6bcec4]. Solo Starter admin with 8 days left and no signal of momentum since day 4 makes unaided key milestone possible but not likely.

draft.subject: Next step after your first Granite Media project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Nice work getting your first project set up in Wrenfield. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real work into that project is usually the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whichever next step is most useful for you.

Best,
Priya
